title: Ignoring the charts, gold records and Billboard
summary: He did not follow Billboard charts since a studio was paid once; the interviewer notes four R&B top-ten records in February 1954, which Billboard never remarked on.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song
